app.title: Deer Planner
app.taglineLong: Capture your event once. Share a beautiful invitation with every guest.
app.taglineBody: Deer Planner is the calm command centre for wedding planners, birthday hosts, and corporate event organizers — capture guest data once and let the platform handle the invitation, the RSVP, and the post-event album.
app.footerNote: Bilingual UI · EN default · ES auto-detected from your browser. PC & tablet optimized.

invitation.subtitle: The public invitation experience is built on top of the same templated data you capture here. We'll wire the visual renderer in a follow-up milestone — for now, share this link to confirm the round-trip works end-to-end.
